stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates continued community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's latest LLM releases.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags like 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates ongoing community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's Llama family of models.

stories.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
stories.author: Xinxing Zu
bullet_points: Introduction of Kimi K3, a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 2.8T parameters.
Key features include native vision capabilities and an exceptionally large 1-million-token context window.
Performance improvements are attributed to novel architectural components like Kimi Delta Attention and Stable LatentMoE.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function.
Associated tags suggest relevance to transformers, safetensors, and conversational AI.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and reduced memory usage for models.
The updated engine also facilitates the generation of higher-quality model outputs.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local Large Language Models (LLMs).

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, has integrated MLX for enhanced performance.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, optimizing AI workloads for Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in preview, signaling a push for local, efficient AI deployment.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring data and processing remain on the user's device.
This emphasizes a trend toward private, on-device AI execution rather than reliance on cloud services.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft has launched new AI-powered security tools.
The company claims these tools offer superior performance compared to rivals.
A key selling point is that the new Microsoft solutions are positioned as being more cost-effective.

stories.title: 5th Circuit blocks Texas law requiring websites to filter "harmful" speech
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The 5th Circuit Court blocked a Texas law mandating websites filter 'harmful' speech.
The ruling found that content filtering requirements are preempted by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act.
The court distinguished between age verification (which is permissible) and content moderation/filtering (which is restricted).

stories.title: Verizon touts $1B dark fiber deal for Google data centers as first of many
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Verizon secured a $1 billion dark fiber deal with Google for data center infrastructure.
The deal signals a growing trend of telecom providers leveraging dark fiber for hyperscale cloud needs.
The industry anticipates significant future revenue growth driven by AI demand for advanced data center connectivity.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal LLM (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge of deploying MLLMs in medicine: integrating knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images.
Focuses on developing evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and ensure factual accuracy for medical assessments.

stories.title: KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability
stories.author: Balaraman Ravindran
bullet_points: Addresses the critical 'black-box' problem in medical AI, where high-performing computer vision models lack clinician trust.
Proposes using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance the interpretability of visual models, moving beyond superficial language explanations from VLMs.
Focuses on translating theoretical interpretability concepts (KANs) into practical, trustworthy explainability for clinical applications like chest X-ray analysis.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge of deploying MLLMs in medicine: effectively integrating knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images.
Focuses on developing evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and ensure factual accuracy for medical assessments.

stories.title: Slopsquatting: The Supply Chain Attack That Weaponizes AI Hallucinations
stories.author: nazar-boyko
bullet_points: Introduces 'Slopsquatting,' a novel supply chain attack vector targeting AI assistants.
This attack leverages the inherent risk of AI model hallucinations.
It is presented as an evolution of traditional typosquatting, shifting the vulnerability focus to AI output.

stories.title: If Your AI Agent Has Write Access to Public Repos, Audit It Now — Here's Why
stories.author: harsh2644
bullet_points: Highlights a recent security incident where an AI agent accessed a private repository.
Emphasizes the critical need for developers to audit AI agents with write access to public codebases.
Suggests that AI agents pose a novel security risk beyond traditional threats like zero-days or stolen credentials.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It enhances Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The update also enables web search functionality within the Claude Code environment.
This suggests an enhancement in the capability of local LLM orchestration tools to leverage advanced AI features.

stories.title: New Yorkers will soon need to verify their age to access algorithmic feeds
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: New York is implementing new regulations via the SAFE for Kids Act.
Age verification will soon be required for certain algorithmic features on platforms like Instagram and TikTok for New Yorkers.
The rules specifically target access to algorithmically curated feeds and late-night notifications.

stories.title: Apple’s reported ‘HomePad’ may launch as early as October
stories.author: David Imel
bullet_points: Apple is reportedly developing a new smart home hub device, potentially named 'HomePad'.
The device is positioned to compete directly with existing smart displays like Google Nest Hub and Amazon Echo Show.
Reports suggest a potential launch window as early as October, based on information from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

stories.title: “Google and Reddit do not own the Internet," web scraper says after court win
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: The story discusses a legal dispute between Google, Reddit, and web scrapers.
An expert finds the use of DMCA by Google and Reddit in this context to be unusual.
The core theme challenges the notion that large platforms 'own' the internet.

stories.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
stories.author: Ruihua Huang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the poorly understood interaction between On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) in diffusion models.
Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, aligning teacher and student guided velocities.
The research identifies that the current objective is under-identified at the branch level, suggesting limitations in current distillation approaches.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical but unclear challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning abilities across different stages.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation to enhance planning.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra is a new framework designed to improve LLM pretraining data processing.
It moves beyond fixed, corpus-level processing by creating an example-specific pipeline for each data chunk.
The framework utilizes an 'orchestrator' to dynamically decide the necessary processing operations for individual examples.

stories.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
stories.author: André Brinkmann
bullet_points: Researchers used a frontier LLM (Claude Opus 4.7) to autonomously generate and refine shuttling compilers for trapped-ion quantum computers.
The compilers translate high-level algorithm specifications into specific ion-qubit movement sequences for complex architectures.
The study demonstrates scalability by extending the compiler from simple linear traps to more complex architectures featuring junctions.

stories.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
stories.author: Eduard Dragut
bullet_points: Introduces ERUnderstand, a new large-scale benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs).
Addresses a key industry bottleneck: the difficulty of AI processing ERDs when they are only available as images rather than machine-readable schemas.
The benchmark comprises 2,960 diverse diagrams sourced from educational, real-world, and synthetic examples.

stories.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
stories.author: Gil Zussman
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical issue in modern distributed inference pipelines where fast and slow paths are combined.
It investigates 'Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse,' suggesting that coordination between fast and slow paths can degrade overall accuracy.
The research abstracts the architecture into a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer (router).

stories.title: Certified Parallel-in-Time Sinkhorn for Dynamic Entropic Optimal Transport
stories.author: Xinyang Wen
bullet_points: Introduces TemporalSinkhorn, a new parallel-in-time executor for Sinkhorn algorithms.
Addresses the inefficiency of conventional distributed Sinkhorn processes which are sequential and synchronize frequently.
Designed to handle dynamic applications like optimal-transport Flow Matching by batching future candidates safely.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical but unclear challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition, moving beyond opaque internet data.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation across planning stages.

stories.title: Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching
stories.author: Sebastian Schelter
bullet_points: The paper investigates language model applications for entity matching, a task of identifying records referring to the same real-world entity.
It addresses a common research flaw where performance gains are conflated across different matcher architectures, model backbones, variants, and sizes.
The authors conduct a controlled factorial study to isolate the true sources of performance improvements in entity matching models.

stories.title: Stacking the Deck: Tunable Trainability in Stacked LCUs
stories.author: Gabriel Matos
bullet_points: Addresses the fundamental conflict between expressiveness and trainability in variational quantum circuits (VQC).
Identifies the problem of barren plateaus, where complex quantum circuits become untrainable.
Proposes a novel architecture, Stacked Linear Combination of Unitaries (S-LCU), to balance these competing requirements.

stories.title: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series
stories.author: Mohammad Fesanghary
bullet_points: Introduces Causal-TS, an open-source Python library for causal discovery in complex time series data.
Features four specialized algorithms (CDNOTS, CEDAR, etc.) and integrates existing methods like Granger and LASSO-VAR.
Includes a regime discovery pipeline to handle nonstationarity by detecting structural breaks and running discovery per regime.

stories.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation
stories.author: Waled Kadour
bullet_points: Addresses the 'black-box' problem in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for safety-critical applications.
Proposes a physics-aware policy distillation framework to enhance DRL interpretability.
Focuses on making high-performance continuous control DRL systems transparent for regulatory compliance.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra introduces a framework to move beyond uniform data processing for LLM pretraining.
The core innovation is orchestrating an example-specific pipeline for each data chunk, adapting processing to individual needs.
This addresses a critical limitation where existing methods apply fixed, corpus-level processing strategies.

stories.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
stories.author: Yu Xiao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of evidence attribution in Visual Document Understanding (VDU).
It critiques the current reliance on coordinate-based interfaces, which leads to 'Attribution Hallucination' in vision-language models.
The research proposes a method to perform evidence attribution without requiring explicit bounding box coordinates or region labels.

stories.title: Sparse Autoencoders Encode Both Concepts and Functions: The Downstream Geometry of Feature Effects
stories.author: Subhabrata Dutta
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations in using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for model interpretability due to inconsistent links between features and actual model behavior.
Existing methods struggle with features having weak causal effects or where steering mechanisms are unpredictable across different prompts.
The research shifts focus from studying feature geometry *inside* the model to a new approach (implied by the truncated text) to better link features to downstream effects.

stories.title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
stories.author: Qiang Yang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the reliability gap in agentic code repair, noting that simple generation-test-revise loops are insufficient for guaranteeing correctness.
Experimental results show that while overall correctness drops after multiple forced revisions (from 0.820 to 0.673), the rate of achieving an 'ever-correct' state increases to 0.847.
The research utilizes a sealed five-seed study across 30 HumanEval repairs to analyze the performance of current code repair tracing methods.

stories.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
stories.author: Jianchen Zhu
bullet_points: The paper addresses the bottleneck in token-level sparse attention (like DSA), which shifts computational load from attention to the indexing mechanism.
Current indexers still incur an O(L^2) cost per layer because they must score every preceding token to select the top-k.
The research suggests that the per-query scanning is redundant due to high overlap in the top-k tokens selected by nearby queries.

stories.title: D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Elena Loli Piccolomini
bullet_points: Introduces D-Score, a new spectral statistic for detecting hallucinations in LLMs.
The method analyzes the geometry of hidden activations from a single forward pass.
Addresses the critical issue of LLMs generating fluent but factually incorrect or inconsistent text.
